stance_basis: letter explicitly states 'no comments' on the project after appropriate consultation
summary: The Cook County Planning Commission, through its Department of Planning and Development, submitted a letter stating it had no comments on NIPC project 74-228 (Lincoln Highway widening) after appropriate consultation under OMB Circular A-95. The Commission neither supported nor opposed the project, simply declining to comment. No substantive position on the merits of the project was expressed.
complaint_summary: The Cook County Planning Commission stated it had no comments on NIPC 74-228 (among other listed projects) after appropriate consultation under OMB Circular A-95.
